'**Earth Fusion** / If Entangle was **fused**, it gains "If this hits a hero, their first attack during their next turn has -2{p}."' Elemental Guardian Action - Attack.

FUSION ITSELF NOT AUTHORED: Earth Fusion fires engine-side from the card DB keywords field as an optional additional cost at PLAY time (ability_keywords.fusion), which writes the marker 'fused_<card.slug>' into the controller's current_turn_effects (ability_keywords.py:604); FLAG_SET (condition_types.py:1032) tests exactly that set. Flag name is per-printing because fusion() keys it on card.slug - hence fused_entangle_red. This is the verified live idiom (shipped siy/aether_icevein_blue.json and ele/chilling_icevein_yellow.json; sibling drafts emerging_avalanche_*, blizzard_bolt_*, brain_freeze_*). Timing holds: fusion resolves as a play cost BEFORE the PLAY ability resolves, and ability-level conditions are checked at resolution (interpreter.py:54-58), so by then the flag is set or permanently absent; entering play unfused leaves it unset and the whole effect skips - Entangle is then a vanilla attack, matching the printed text.

GAINS-CLAUSE VEHICLE: INJECT_TRIGGER with explicit COMBAT scope (default anyway - fires once, on the current attack). The inner trigger dict is REQUIRED nesting: a top-level conditions key would be popped by the loader as an effect-level gate evaluated once at registration, when there may be no attack. Inner ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gates 'hits a hero'.

THE -2{p}: MODIFY_ATTACKS_THIS_TURN handler (effect_types.py:2201-2227, read this session) reads amount/mod/scope/player/filter. mod 'subtract' signs the amount negative; scope NEXT_TURN parks the hook on the opponent's next_turn_attack_hooks (state.py:900-905), promoted into turn_attack_hooks at the OWNER'S next turn start (engine.py:343) - exactly 'during their next turn'.

'THEIR FIRST attack': filter ATTACK_ORDINAL_EQ amount 1 (condition_types.py:672-683, read - the param is 'amount'). It compares the ATTACKER's attacks_this_turn == 1; that counter resets to 0 in the same turn-start promotion that activates the hook (engine.py:345) and increments once per attack entering the chain (engine.py:539), so it is true during their first attack of that turn only. The filter key (not conditions) is deliberate: conditions would be popped as a registration-time gate, while filter is pass-through data re-compiled against EACH incoming attack by engine._apply_turn_attack_effects.

RELEASE NOTE ('This affects all attacks including attack actions and weapon attacks') holds by construction: the filter carries NO type/subtype restriction, and attacks_this_turn counts every attack the player makes - action or weapon.

Triage list followed essentially verbatim - it was accurate for this card; each named primitive was read in its handler before use. On adoption, pick the json/<set>/ folder from the card's setIdentifiers (batch label says TalesOfAria), not from the batch.
